scope: Brazilian champions as recognised by the CBF: 1937 Torneio dos Campeões (recognised August 2023), Taça Brasil 1959-1968 and Torneio Roberto Gomes Pedrosa 1967-1970 (unified December 2010), and the national championship / Série A from 1971 (incl. the 2000 Copa João Havelange). No national championship existed 1938-1958, so those years have no rows. 1967 and 1968 each have two rows (tournament = "Taça Brasil" / "Torneio Roberto Gomes Pedrosa"). Calendar-year seasons through 2025
source: Wikipedia season articles (YYYY Campeonato Brasileiro Série A) league tables (cross-check, points 2003-2025)

fieldNotes.footsimuId: ESPN team id (the id FootSimu uses); present for some clubs not in FootSimu leagues
fieldNotes.footsimuSlug: club page slug on footsimu.com, only for clubs in a FootSimu league in 2026-27
fieldNotes.footsimuPath: club page path under the league the club plays in now, without locale
fieldNotes.points: final points (3 per win); only for round-robin seasons (1937 and 2003 onward); null for cup/play-off formats
fieldNotes.name: club name used in the source for that season
fieldNotes.currentName: club as known today (FootSimu name where available)
fieldNotes.tournament: "Taça Brasil" or "Torneio Roberto Gomes Pedrosa" for the two parallel championships of 1967 and 1968; null otherwise
fieldNotes.competition: name of the national championship that year
fieldNotes.strippedChampion: not used; the 1987 dispute is documented in notes (official champion Sport Recife)

Disputed title: the CBF and the 2017 Supreme Federal Court (STF) ruling recognise Sport Recife as the sole 1987 champion (the CBF scheduled a final quadrangular between the top two of the Green and Yellow Modules; Flamengo and Internacional refused to play, and Sport beat Guarani in the remaining matches). Flamengo won the Copa União (Green Module, organised by Clube dos Treze, runner-up Internacional) and still claims the title; the CBF briefly recognised both in 2011 before the courts restored Sport as sole champion. Runner-up Guarani; third Flamengo per the official classification
